Template [V3] - Late 2018 - 2019
(OG 2.0)
Information: Slight Modify, now the Availability entries could be selected and The bar above has a darker gray. Includes a News bar on the case there would be important information to highlight and an "Availability Graphics" Tab. Also the Name, Info, Links and availability questions had tiny boxes where it explained basically what was it

Information: 2020 Template. Notable differences is the "Landing Page" Tab, Separation entry that indicated when an era ended or started indicating the action the Artist Made. Includes a Fakes Tab. Includes Leak Date, OG FILE Date and more availability type entries.
